text: Thirty days to ascend.
This is Paul. He has thirty days.
The group chat drops its Tier List. Paul is Rat Tier.
Day one. Paul rates his own face.
The mirror says: three out of ten.
Then it asks to be left out of this.
Next: mewing. Tongue on the roof of the mouth.
Three days. Zero words.
Verdict: nobody noticed. Nobody spoke.
The jaw trainer. Ten thousand chews.
Jawline update: still a loaf of bread.
Hunter eyes! Canthal tilt, plus twelve. Vision, minus twelve.
Heightmaxxing: platform shoes. Plus four inches.
Paul is now taller than most doorframes.
Mogged by an actual doorframe.
Day one results: P S L, zero point zero.
But Paul has a plan. Frame is everything.
At least his frame is excellent. It is solid oak.
Day two: pick his weapon.
Comment MEW or MOG. Winner trains first.
Day two starts soon. Thirty days to ascend.
